inputs: SP 800-38A Appendix F.4.1 AES-128-OFB four-block vector
expected: All four ciphertext blocks match the NIST values; decryption recovers all four plaintext blocks
limitations: One official four-block case; not full-message protocol validation.

inputs: Two fixed plaintexts under the same AES-128 key and IV, then under a different IV
expected: Same-IV ciphertext XOR equals plaintext XOR; a different IV breaks the relation
limitations: Keystream-reuse arithmetic; it does not model a full protocol attack.

expected: Ciphertext length equals plaintext length in both cases; no padding block is added
limitations: Length and round-trip behavior only; it does not test every partial length.

inputs: Keystream generated from a zero plaintext, then used to decrypt a fixed ciphertext
expected: The precomputed keystream recovers the same plaintext as direct OFB decryption
limitations: Demonstrates keystream independence on fixed data; not a timing or precomputation benchmark.
